parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EaisName
parameters.description: The name of the EAIS instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: EaisType
parameters.description: The instance type of the EAIS instance. This parameter can only be set to **eais.ei-a6.2xlarge**.

parameters.name: EnvironmentVar
parameters.description: Set one or more environment variables during the initialization of the EAIS instance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_), and cannot start with a digit.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the environment variable. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides. For a list of the latest Alibaba Cloud regions, see [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the EAIS instance belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. The list can contain up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. Constraints:

- The tag key cannot be empty.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The tag key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- The tag key cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. Constraints:

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The tag value cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- The tag value cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs.

> The number of available IP addresses in the vSwitch CIDR block determines the maximum number of EAIS instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan your CIDR block settings in advance.
